question: At what offset relative to an engine-truth onset or release does a masked frame pair first contain cross-session visual evidence of that exact transition?

data.continuity: common support requires every engine index from t-5 through t+17 to be consecutive, every row in that interval to have input_active=1, and t-1 to remain inside the same session/run; +17 is scored only as the adjacent confirmation for candidate +16

pair_definition: for target transition at t and offset o, use ordered pair (frame[t+o-1], frame[t+o])

probe_surfaces.pooled_imagenet: frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 average-pool features [previous,current,signed delta,absolute delta] (2048-D) with a deterministic linear sigmoid probe
probe_surfaces.spatial_motion_control: frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 layer3 features adaptive-average-pooled to 4x4, using [current,signed difference,absolute difference] (12288-D) with the same linear-probe family
probe_surfaces.same_frame_controls: pooled current or spatial current alone at the same offset; pair lift over this control is required for differential evidence

fit.loss: 14-output class-balanced BCE; positive weight min(negative/positive,50) from training sessions only
fit.checkpoint_selection: final epoch only; no validation early stopping or hyperparameter search
fit.robustness: three leave-one-training-session-out folds are scored before the final val-A confirmation
fit.thresholds: none fitted; average precision and AP skill decide this diagnostic

metrics.primary: per-key onset/release average precision on post-state-conditioned validation support: onset among keys[t]=1 and release among keys[t]=0
secondary: average precision on all eligible validation targets at natural prevalence
persistent-post-state, no-intervening-action, and solo/co-occurring transition subsets
metrics.minimum_supported_positives: 30 on val-A and at least 20 in two of three training sessions
metrics.uncertainty: paired 10-second continuity-bounded fixed-ranking AP-contribution block bootstrap with 5000 deterministic replicates (seed 2026072701), arithmetic-mean aggregation of the three per-seed metric values, and simultaneous max-absolute-deviation bands over offsets
metrics.null: 5000 deterministic continuity-run-bounded circular shifts (seed 2026072702); independently sample one legal offset per retained run uniformly with replacement, circular distance >=300 rows; exclude runs shorter than 600 rows and report retained rows/positives/null-inestimability; shift truth, post-state, and t-5..t+17 key context together while predictions remain fixed
metrics.multiplicity: BH-FDR q=0.05 over 2 pair representations x 5 candidate horizons x 14 tasks

scoring.bootstrap_statistic: arithmetic mean of the three per-seed post-state-conditioned normalized AP-skill values; probabilities are not ensembled
scoring.short_run_policy: continuity runs shorter than 600 rows are excluded from the shift-null surface; gaps and run boundaries are never crossed
scoring.circular_sampling: one legal circular offset is sampled independently per retained run, uniformly with replacement across replicates
scoring.shifted_bundle: truth, post-state, and t-5..t+17 key context shift together; predictions remain fixed
scoring.null_statistic: on retained long-run rows, the post-state-conditioned mean predicted-score contrast (event minus same-post-state non-event), after arithmetic averaging of the three seed probabilities, at candidate h minus the maximum corresponding contrast over -4..-1
scoring.null_tail: one-sided upper: count null statistic >= observed statistic
scoring.fdr_family: 2 pair representations x 5 candidate horizons x 14 onset/release tasks; null-inestimable hypotheses remain in the denominator and fail
scoring.adjacent_confirmation: candidate start h must separately pass effect, simultaneous-CI, and LOSO gates at h+1; +17 is confirmation-only for candidate +16; FDR applies at h without expanding the frozen 140-hypothesis family

interpretation.detectable_output: smallest candidate h in {1,2,4,8,16} for which h and h+1 both have post-state-conditioned causal AP-skill lift at least 0.03, pair-over-same-frame lift at least 0.01, simultaneous lower confidence bounds above zero, positive val-A lift, and positive lift in at least two leave-one-session-out folds; the frozen FDR test applies at h and +17 exists only to confirm candidate +16
interpretation.precausal_baseline: best normalized AP skill over offsets -4..-1 for the same task and representation
interpretation.global_horizon_gate: macro conditioned causal lift >=0.03 with lower CI >0; macro pair lift >=0.01 with lower CI >0; natural-support lower CI >-0.01; at least 7 of 14 estimable tasks spanning four keys and both polarities; positive in two LOSO folds; above shifted null; and half of supported tasks retain at least half their lift without intervening actions
interpretation.negative_offsets: evidence at negative offsets is anticipation, scene correlation, or leakage—not a post-action visual effect
interpretation.broad_positive_peak: evidence spread across later offsets supports effect recognition but weak exact-frame identifiability
interpretation.scope_limit: a failed pooled probe can indict current pooled features but cannot prove pixels lack the information; the spatial-motion control is required before that stronger conclusion

embargo.rule: must not be opened, read, inferred, fitted, calibrated, or scored
